messages:
carmen: Heads-up: launching a FedRAMP Readiness Concierge pilot for Private deployments. It pairs a Solutions engineer + Compliance reviewer to accelerate customer audits. Pilot starts next month; signups open to invited enterprise customers only. Please read the short plan and ACK.

ishaan: Link to the plan? Scope?

carmen: Plan: https://redwood.internal/priv/fedramp-concierge-plan. Scope: help customers prepare evidence bundles, run an auditor staging session, and deliver an attestation pack. Concierge includes 4 hours of eng support + 2 hours legal consult.

maya-devex: DevEx will create the customer-facing signup + FAQ. We should include standard timeline (2 weeks prep) and what we need from customers (network allowlist, point-of-contact, signed access attestation).

dave-sre: Infra note: concierge sessions will use ephemeral auditor clusters with enforced TTL and read-only tokens. Default TTL 24h. We'll need a small quota bump for pilot — proposing 3x T4 per concierge session.

sara-legal: Legal: we'll require a signed Inspector Access Agreement and an NDA for external auditors. We'll provide a short attestation template and need the customer's acceptance recorded in CRM before issuing tokens.

carmen: Pricing: pilot is free; post-pilot we'll offer as a paid add-on. Sam-sales is drafting pricing bands. For now, we just need engineering and legal sign-off to start the pilot invites.

announce-bot: Pilot cohort signup opened: https://redwood.internal/priv/fedramp-concierge/apply (invites only).

ishaan: ACK 38 will prepare infra quotas and an automated manifest for evidence bundles.

maya-devex: ACK 38 will draft signup copy + FAQ and share templates with legal.

sara-legal: ACK 38 uploading attestation + NDA templates to the plan doc.

dave-sre: ACK 38 scheduling quota allocation and monitoring hooks.

carmen: Thanks team. I'll send invites to the pilot cohort and coordinate a dry run next Tue. If anything blocks, post here. :sparkles:
